title: Direct and indirect taxes
examples: What is the difference between direct and indirect taxes?

explain.say: Every time you buy a juice, you might pay a tax without knowing it! Governments collect tax in two main ways. Look at the board: direct taxes in one box, indirect taxes in the other.

See the direct box? A direct tax is paid straight to the government by the person or company that earns or owns, like income tax on wages or tax on company profits. You can see it on a payslip. Who in your home pays income tax?

Now the indirect box. An indirect tax is added to the price of things you buy, and the shop passes it to the government. India's GST, VAT in Nigeria, South Africa and the UK, and fuel duty are all indirect. Have you seen GST on a bill?

Some indirect taxes aim to change habits. Look: in 2014 Mexico taxed sugary drinks one peso per litre. Prices rose and people bought less, and in the UK firms cut sugar to avoid a similar tax. Do you think that is fair?

draw.name: x-why
draw.question: Why tax sugary drinks?
draw.answer: Healthier choices, plus money for health

explain.say: Direct taxes often take more from people who earn more; indirect taxes cost everyone the same per item, so they take a bigger share from poorer families. Great sorting! Wow: VAT was invented by French official Maurice Laure in 1954 and is now used in over 170 countries.

faq.a: A direct tax is paid directly to the government by the person or business it is charged on, such as income tax, company tax or property tax.
An indirect tax is charged on goods and services and collected by sellers, who pass it to the government. Shoppers pay it inside the price. GST, VAT and fuel duty are examples.

To make them dearer so people drink less and companies use less sugar, aiming to cut problems like obesity and diabetes, and to raise money for health. Critics say such taxes hit poorer families harder.
Value added tax is an indirect tax charged at each stage of making and selling a product, on the value added at that stage. India's version is called GST.

faq.q: Which kind of tax is fairer?
faq.a: People disagree. Direct taxes can be set to take more from high earners; indirect taxes are harder to avoid and simple to collect. Most countries use a mix of both.

facts: Mexico introduced a tax of 1 peso per litre on sugary drinks in 2014.
VAT was first introduced in France in 1954, designed by Maurice Laure, and is now used in more than 170 countries.
